name: Static ChordRes with a raw branch target
tagline: Preserve attention and MLP output magnitude during spherical updates.
description: The proposed displacement is F minus h. The new position is RMS-normalized and the three-gain velocity write uses the realized displacement on the new tangent plane.
mechanism: Raw BF16 attention or MLP output as the position target
Two scalar position steps in the original directions
Unit-RMS position, projected three-gain tangent velocity
limitations: Matched-normal research initialization with a scalar LR override. The 8,000-update segment is an intermediate checkpoint.
